name: WorldLook
author: Dominik
description: One world-look mod: clock-weighted warm light, the reference water surface, and a manual rendering probe. Merged from GoldenHour, WaterShader and GraphicsProbe so the game loads one DLL instead of three.
manualTrigger: Ctrl+Shift+F7 toggles the light bias. Ctrl+Shift+F8 captures a read-only rendering report. Water applies itself on the Main scene.
reportPath: UserData/GraphicsProbe/latest.json for a manual probe capture; light state is in the MelonLoader log
limitations: Light bias is a mild warm shift at 06:00 and 18:00 and is released at noon and at night. Fog is not enabled. The probe does not scan on scene load; it runs only on the manual chord. Water still targets only Main/Map/StylizedWater2_Ocean. In-Game-Verify open.
removal: With the game closed, remove Mods/WorldLook.dll, Mods/s1reference.bundle and the optional PDB. Also remove any leftover GoldenHour.dll, WaterShader.dll and GraphicsProbe.dll so the old look does not load beside this one. Keep Shared.
